_comment: Interceptor policy for the inspection sandbox. The interceptor terminates the inner VM's TLS, reads plaintext, applies this policy, and re-originates a validated TLS connection outward. v0 adopts a mature MITM (mitmproxy/Go); Turn 4 replaces it with the U-written, capability-bounded, M-of-N-blessed version.

volume_metering.note: Content visibility narrows but does not close covert-channel exfil; metering bounds it. Trip the limit -> quarantine the job.

audit.note: Default logs request metadata + SHA-256 of bodies (accountability without hoarding plaintext). Full-plaintext capture is opt-in per investigation.

tls.pinning_contract: standard validation -> transparent; TOFU -> pins to interceptor; baked-in pin you built -> don't bake it; baked-in pin in 3rd-party binary -> fails by design, treated as signal. Never patch the binary to defeat pinning.
